speaker: john_heminges
text: The share is thirty-four shillings. Last Saturday was thirty-eight. I am not opening your coffer.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And I am not giving you a total. Thirty-four is received. It is not a balance.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Thirty-four spends. Pay the Saturday, and let a man be hungry in peace.

speaker: will_kemp
text: On the thirty-first of April this would have been a legend. I will take thirty-four on a Saturday that exists.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Thirty-four. No legend. The hired men are in it as they were last week. I am not rehearsing their wage at this table.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Hear the other thing before you drink it. The court went down to Greenwich today.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Greenwich. Today.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Today. My lord is gone with them, and Kettleby. I had it from the household. They are not in the city. I am not dressing it up.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Kettleby gone, and my lord gone. Then the door is shut on a summons.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Any chance of a summons went with them. Not before Michaelmas. I am not hoping one out of an empty house.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I am not entering a summons. Nothing has come. Thirty-four shillings is the news that has a number.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Michaelmas is a long way to be unpaid by a court. Thirty-four is here. I know which one I can drink.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The clown is still in London. On the thirty-first of April they will all come back with a warrant. I shall wait.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You will wait. Write no warrant. I will not have a hope in the margin of a share.

speaker: john_heminges
text: There is no hope in the book. There is thirty-four, and there is last Saturday's thirty-eight, and there is no total.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The boy who is fifteen gets it in the same ink, and he gets no coin in the letter. I enclose nothing.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Enclose nothing. A brother spends an enclosure. Thirty-four is the company's, not Stratford's.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Stratford is not getting this share. I am not sending a quarter. The letter is a page.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A page and no cake. I said there would not be a second cake. I am sitting down.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Sit, then. The comedy. Abel says it has left his hand. It is not a loss.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tomorrow, under my cloak. The chronicle does not go. The cat is still on the second volume, and Field has been told.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then the book is your Sunday, and the sleeve is Edith's. Leave my entrance where you put it. I like the smaller. I am not making a speech of it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The entrance is not in my book. The share is. Monday is Errors. That is as far as I am setting while the light holds.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Monday is Errors. I have that. I am not taking a roll home for a part I have not been handed.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Monday is enough to write a post. The rest of the week can wait on a drier board.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Will, say the share back, so we do not grow a total between here and your stair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thirty-four shillings. Received. Not a balance. No summons before Michaelmas. The court is at Greenwich.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: He has it. I am going to eat before Kemp finds a proverb that costs money.

speaker: will_kemp
text: My proverbs are free on Saturdays. Sixpence was Wednesday. You may keep your supper.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Enough. Thirty-four. The book is out and back. Greenwich is news and not a sum. God keep you until Monday.
